mintAuthority.summary: Ethereum alUSD is minted through the AlchemistV2 CDP under a token ceiling controlled by two ADMIN_ROLE multisigs. The Alchemist proxy is now administered directly by a separate 3-of-7 Safe. Material Optimism xalUSD is minted by a rate-limited LayerZero bridge; its 3-of-7 chain Safe owns both that bridge and the token ProxyAdmin and can replace or raise its limits.

controls.label: AlchemistV2 (CDP minter)
controls.capDescription: AlToken.ceiling(AlchemistV2) is an administrator-set token mint ceiling; Alchemist collateral and LTV checks further constrain user issuance. The contract cannot raise its own ceiling.
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25712278, AlToken.ceiling(AlchemistV2) returned 1,000,000,000,000 alUSD and hasMinted returned about 21.94 million alUSD. The proxy still used implementation 0x0f17d856ecc7c8ce9bd7d5b3e52a47eca5e8955a, while its EIP-1967 admin had changed from the previously recorded ProxyAdmin to 3-of-7 Safe 0xf56d660138815fc5d7a06cd0e1630225e788293d. The Alchemist cannot raise its own token ceiling.

controls.label: Alchemix MultiSigWalletWithTimeLock (ADMIN_ROLE)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25712278, AlToken ADMIN_ROLE still had exactly two members including this MultiSigWalletWithTimeLock. getOwners() returned seven owners, required() returned 4, and secondsTimeLocked() returned 600 seconds. ADMIN_ROLE can authorize minters and raise their token ceilings but cannot mint directly.

controls.label: Alchemix AlToken ADMIN_ROLE Safe
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25712278, this Safe remained the second of exactly two AlToken ADMIN_ROLE members. Safe API returned the listed 3-of-7 owners, no modules, zero guard and module guard, and Safe 1.3.0. It can authorize minters and raise token ceilings, but the Alchemist proxy-admin role has moved to the separately modeled Safe 0xf56d660138815fc5d7a06cd0e1630225e788293d.

controls.label: Alchemix AlchemistV2 proxy-admin Safe (via ProxyAdmin 0xe0fc5cb7)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25712278, the AlchemistV2 EIP-1967 admin slot resolved directly to this Safe, replacing the stale ProxyAdmin/owner path recorded previously. Safe API returned a 3-of-7 quorum with no modules and zero guards. It can replace collateral and mint-critical Alchemist logic without an external timelock.

controls.label: Optimism xalUSD LayerZero bridge minter
controls.capDescription: The xalUSD xBridge entry limits this LayerZero bridge to a 1,000,000 alUSD replenishing mint capacity; the bridge cannot change its own allowance.
controls.evidence: At Optimism block 155309063, xBridges(this bridge) returned a 1,000,000 alUSD max mint limit with about 996,936 alUSD currently available. bridge.owner() returned the separately modeled Optimism Safe; token() returned xalUSD and endpoint() returned the canonical LayerZero V2 endpoint.

controls.label: Alchemix Optimism xalUSD admin Safe
controls.evidence: At Optimism block 155309063, this Safe remained owner of both the LayerZero bridge minter and ProxyAdmin 0xa44f69aeac480e23c0abfa9a55d99c9f098beac6; the xalUSD proxy retained implementation 0x29ef9f2fa6f636eafe74e5fba057c7949a37ffa6. Safe API returned 3-of-7 owners, no modules, and zero guards. It can raise bridge limits or replace xalUSD mint logic.

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 25712278, AlToken ADMIN_ROLE still had the 4-of-7 ten-minute multisig and 3-of-7 Safe as its only members, while AlchemistV2 remained cap-limited by the token ceiling. Correction: the Alchemist proxy admin is now the separate 3-of-7 Safe 0xf56d660138815fc5d7a06cd0e1630225e788293d, not the stale ProxyAdmin path. At Optimism block 155309063, the material xalUSD route retained a 1,000,000 alUSD replenishing LayerZero bridge limit; its 3-of-7 Safe owns the bridge and token ProxyAdmin and can raise or replace those constraints. Aggregate cap semantics are raiseable; reconciliation is on-chain/not applicable and no prudential supervisor applies.
